title: How do I archive (delete) a wallet?
description:

Tap and ...
body:
1. Locate the Asset List Screen by tapping on Assets at the lower left

  2. Locate the name of the Wallet that you would like to Archive

  3. Tap and hold on the wallet until a menu appears or tap into the wallet and tap the three vertical dots

  4. Tap on "Archive Wallet"

  5. Confirm and tap on "Archive" again

NOTE: You can restore any archived wallets by tapping Menu > Settings > Restore Wallets.
